additional_info.subject: ID0370948-DC/SICD/FR-[MP / R8 170002510]-Payment terminal CRM:01282000408
additional_info.body:
Hello ,
For the payment terminal error :
Possible causes may include:
- A defective or disconnected network cable
- A faulty network switch
- A defective or disconnected power supply for the payment terminal
- An incorrect IP address for the payment terminal
To check the network configuration of the payment terminal, ensure the following settings:
- Static IP address: 10.20.17.50
- Subnet mask: 255.255.255.0
- Gateway: 10.20.17.2
- DNS: 10.20.17.2
Proceed to ping the terminal using IP: 10.20.17.50.
It's crucial to verify that all connections are secure and match the schematic. Additionally, consider testing or replacing the Ethernet cable to rule out any issues with it.
The Ethernet connection should be configured as follows:
Payment terminal > LAN cable > Switch > LAN cable > Router 2
Even then the error persist, you may consider replacing the component.
